title: React v2 Report Center: run selector, adaptive report catalog, markdown/HTML/PDF preview, and download actions
goal: Build src/components/screens/ReportCenter.tsx. REQUIRES backlog-268. Layout: two tabs at top ('Reports' | 'Dossier'). REPORTS TAB — Left column (report catalog, 40%): Run selector strip at top showing the selected run (profile name, date, status). Below: card grid of available reports from GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/reports. Each card shows: report type icon (FileText, Shield, BarChart3 from Lucide), report title, availability status badge (export_ready/generating/unavailable), short description. Clicking a card: select it, load preview. Right column (report preview + actions, 60%): When report selected: show report metadata header (title, run reference, generated date). Three action buttons: 'Generate Markdown Preview' (POST to generate, then show in <pre> block), 'Download HTML' (calls download endpoint), 'Download PDF' (calls pdf endpoint). Below action buttons: inline preview area showing the markdown as formatted HTML (use a simple markdown-to-html renderer, no external libraries needed — just handle # headers, ** bold, - lists, ``` code blocks). Compare section at bottom: 'Compare with Earlier Run' selector — dropdown of previous runs for the same engagement, on select shows a diff summary (N new findings, N resolved findings). DOSSIER TAB: Call GET /api/v1/engagements/{engId}/dossier. Show: engagement name, client, all runs as a timeline (date, profile, status, findings count). Click a run to jump to it in Mission Control. No report generation here, just history overview. Evidence hash for each report shown as a collapsed disclosure: 'Show SHA-256' opens the raw hash. Evidence is verified: shown as 'Evidence hash: verified' with a green checkmark.
scope: React v2 Report Center replaces the old reports.js.
generation_reason: Report Center is the output delivery screen. Must show real reports with download and preview.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.

success_criteria: Clicking a report card loads preview.
Generate Markdown Preview button shows formatted markdown.
Download HTML and PDF trigger file downloads.
Compare with Earlier Run shows diff summary.
Evidence hash shown in collapsed disclosure.
